{{Short description|List of high mountains in Antarctica}}
{{More citations needed|date=January 2019}}
This is a list of all the [[ultra prominent peak]]s (with [[topographic prominence]] greater than 1,500 metres) in [[Antarctica]]. Some islands in the [[South Atlantic]] have also been included and can be found at the end of the list.
